name: OmaShaders
author: AktOn1
description: One bar icon, four effect menus you can tick side by side: Screen (full-screen GLSL effects on the GPU), Color (a colour grade that overrides the effect's colours), Wallpaper (41 animated wallpaper effects, wallpaper picker) and Cursor (overlays around the mouse). Hover preview, favorites, Surprise me, GPU use.

barWidget.description: Click to open the menu: tick Screen, Color, Wallpaper and Cursor, hover to preview, Enter to keep. Right-click turns effects off, scroll steps the screen shader.

schema.label: Include animated screen shaders (heavy GPU use)
Frame rate of wallpaper and cursor effects
Cursor effects and wallpaper mouse reactions only while Shift is held (needs a Hyprland Shift_L binding, see README)
